reason: I'd sign up for the free plan, maybe, but 50 conversations a month is nothing and I'd rather live with the badge than pay. My site is a showcase site, a chat mascot is a nice-to-have, not something I'd pay 29 a month for.
objection: I could build this myself with an LLM API and a weekend, and a cute animated face isn't worth 29 EUR a month when there are free chatbot widgets. I'd check G2 and Capterra first and probably pick a free one.
would_change_my_mind: A free plan with several hundred conversations and no badge, or a one-time price under 10 EUR, with clear proof it lifts leads on a site like mine.
